frameworks.name: Stay Ready Framework
frameworks.definition: Greg LaVecchia's operational definition of discipline: maintaining a state of ongoing readiness so that preparation is continuous rather than reactive to opportunity.

claims.text: Greg LaVecchia asserts that the ability to show up more days in a row than anyone else increases one's chances of luck and preparedness for opportunities, because discipline sustains readiness continuously rather than reactively; those who maintain this discipline are prepared for whatever the market or environment presents, while those who do not are caught unprepared.
claims.speaker: Greg LaVecchia
conditions: Applies to founders and creators competing in markets where sustained output compounds over time
claims.mechanism: Continuous readiness means no gap between opportunity arriving and being able to act; those who must 'get ready' lose the window to those who are already ready.

practices.text: Treat discipline as the greatest form of self-respect; if you cannot show up consistently, no other business skill compounds.
